map.剩余本金和已还本金是一回事吗？: Is remaining principal the same as principal already repaid?
map.不是。已还本金=总还款−已付利息，剩余本金=原贷款−已还本金。等额本息前期已付利: No. Principal repaid = total paid − interest paid; remaining principal = original loan − principal repaid. Under equal installments the early interest paid is large, so remaining principal falls slowly.
map.提前还款能省多少利息？: How much interest can early repayment save?
map.省下的是剩余本金在未来各期本应付的利息。提前还本金越多、越早，节省越多；部分银行: What is saved is the interest that would otherwise have been paid on the remaining principal in future periods. The more and earlier you repay, the more you save; some banks charge a prepayment penalty, so compare after netting it out.
